verses.text: When I would heal Israel, The iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, And the evil deeds of Samaria, For they deal falsely; The thief enters in, Bandits raid outside,
verses.textZh: 我想醫治以色列的時候，以法蓮的罪孽和撒瑪利亞的罪惡就顯露出來。他們行事虛謊，內有賊人入室偷竊，外有強盜成群騷擾。

verses.text: And they do not consider in their hearts That I remember all their wickedness. Now their deeds are all around them; They are before My face.
verses.textZh: 他們心裡並不思想我記念他們的一切惡；他們所行的現在纏繞他們，都在我面前。

verses.text: With their wickedness they make the king glad, And the princes with their lies.
verses.textZh: 他們行惡使君王歡喜，說謊使首領喜樂。

verses.text: They are all adulterers, Like an oven heated by the baker Who ceases to stir up [the fire] From the kneading of the dough until it is leavened.
verses.textZh: 他們都是行淫的，像火爐被烤餅的燒熱，從摶麵到發麵的時候，暫不使火著旺。

verses.text: On the day of our king, the princes became sick with the heat of wine; He stretched out his hand with scoffers,
verses.textZh: 在我們王宴樂的日子，首領因酒的烈性成病；王與褻慢人拉手。

verses.text: For their hearts are like an oven [As] they approach their plotting; Their anger smolders all night, In the morning it burns like a flaming fire.
verses.textZh: 首領埋伏的時候，心中熱如火爐，就如烤餅的整夜睡臥，到了早晨火氣炎炎。

verses.text: All of them are hot like an oven, And they consume their rulers; All their kings have fallen. None of them calls on Me.
verses.textZh: 眾民也熱如火爐，燒滅他們的官長。他們的君王都仆倒而死；他們中間無一人求告我。

verses.text: Ephraim mixes himself with the nations; Ephraim has become a cake not turned.
verses.textZh: 以法蓮與列邦人攙雜；以法蓮是沒有翻過的餅。

verses.text: Strangers devour his strength, Yet he does not know [it]; Gray hairs also are sprinkled on him, Yet he does not know [it].
verses.textZh: 外邦人吞吃他勞力得來的，他卻不知道；頭髮斑白，他也不覺得。

verses.text: Though the pride of Israel testifies against him, Yet they have not returned to the LORD their God, Nor have they sought Him, for all this.
verses.textZh: 以色列的驕傲當面見證自己，雖遭遇這一切，他們仍不歸向耶和華─他們的神，也不尋求他。

verses.text: So Ephraim has become like a silly dove, without sense; They call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
verses.textZh: 以法蓮好像鴿子愚蠢無知；他們求告埃及，投奔亞述。

verses.text: When they go, I will spread My net over them; I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them in accordance with the proclamation to their assembly.
verses.textZh: 他們去的時候，我必將我的網撒在他們身上；我要打下他們，如同空中的鳥。我必按他們會眾所聽見的懲罰他們。

verses.text: Woe to them, for they have strayed from Me! Destruction is theirs, for they have rebelled against Me! I would redeem them, but they speak lies against Me.
verses.textZh: 他們因離棄我，必定有禍；因違背我，必被毀滅。我雖要救贖他們，他們卻向我說謊。

verses.text: And they do not cry to Me from their heart When they wail on their beds; For the sake of grain and new wine they assemble themselves, They turn away from Me.
verses.textZh: 他們並不誠心哀求我，乃在床上呼號；他們為求五穀新酒聚集，仍然悖逆我。

verses.text: Although I trained [and] strengthened their arms, Yet they devise evil against Me.
verses.textZh: 我雖教導他們，堅固他們的膀臂，他們竟圖謀抗拒我。

verses.text: They turn, [but] not upward, They are like a deceitful bow; Their princes will fall by the sword Because of the insolence of their tongue. This [will be] their derision in the land of Egypt.
verses.textZh: 他們歸向，卻不歸向至上者；他們如同翻背的弓。他們的首領必因舌頭的狂傲倒在刀下；這在埃及地必作人的譏笑。
